sloka: हा राक्षसचमूमुख्य मम वत्स महारथ।जित्वेन्द्रं कथमद्य त्वं लक्ष्मणस्य वशं गतः ।। ६.९३.६ ।।
transliteration: hā rākṣasacamūmukhya mama vatsa mahāratha।jitvendraṁ kathamadya tvaṁ lakṣmaṇasya vaśaṁ gataḥ ।। 6.93.6 ।।

translations.english: 'My son who was a chief of the Rakshasa army, a mighty one, who has won even Indra, how has he become a victim of Lakshmana'?
